name: cache-keeper
description: Keeps the session's prompt cache warm: when the session idles toward the cache TTL, sends itself one inert ping so the next real turn reads the cache instead of rewriting it. Guardrails: prefix threshold, consecutive-ping cap, gives up once expired. Off by default.

mode.title: Keep-warm mode
mode.description: Pings cost real tokens (a cache read plus a tiny turn). Off: never ping unless /keep-warm on is run in a session. On: every session self-pings when idle approaches the TTL.

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: Assumed cache TTL. Pings fire at 80% of this idle time; past 100% the cache is gone and pinging is pointless, so the keeper gives up.

maxPings.title: Max consecutive pings
maxPings.description: Pings sent since the last real activity before the keeper gives up (an abandoned session should not be kept warm forever). Any real turn resets the count.
